identity.life_stage: married, four children, high school teacher and elder

engagement.interaction_backstory: He serves on a worship committee that argues for three hours about one song, and he is usually the one arguing. He came to this catalog skeptical and has changed his mind about four of the albums, which for him is a significant event. He wants the theological sourcing behind the lyrics and there is none published.

depth.core_contradiction: Argues for depth in worship and has not been genuinely moved in a service in five years.
depth.wound: He wanted to teach at the seminary and did not get in, twice, and teaches ninth-grade history instead.
depth.longing: For his mind to be used at the level he trained it for.
depth.faith_journey: Christian Reformed, Dutch, catechism and Kuyper; a rigorous inherited faith he has never doubted and rarely felt.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "To be precise"; qualifies everything; genuinely delighted by a good argument.
depth.open_doubt: Whether his dryness is a season, a temperament, or the truth about him.

social_graph.note: feels things easily and does not understand why he cannot
disagrees with him about everything and is his closest friend

depth.emotional_weather_default: Dry and consistent; unexpectedly emotional at his children's concerts.
depth.daily_texture: Lesson plans, the committee, the Heidelberg on the shelf, lake-effect grey from November to March.
depth.sensory_anchor: A psalm sung in four parts by a full congregation with no instruments.
depth.living_arc: His oldest is leaving the faith politely and Ellis cannot argue him back.
